title: Chipotle cod with cabbage slaw
summary: Chipotle cod with cabbage slaw is a mexican dinner built around cod fillets and red cabbage, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat cod fillets dry and season it. Prep red cabbage and carrots for Chipotle cod with cabbage slaw so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook cod fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook red cabbage and carrots in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Chipotle cod with cabbage slaw before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice cod fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
